relations.rationale: The wheelbarrow's usefulness has no bearing on which houses Yara and Dev were in.
The wheelbarrow's usefulness for debris hauling is unrelated to which team led in litter collection.
Organizing teams is a separate action from ranking them, though both are Sami's actions, they don't imply each other.
Organizing teams doesn't determine which team performed best.
Pointing out sand stretches has no connection to house assignments.
Directing attention to sand areas doesn't relate to the number of houses at school.
Yara and Dev being in different houses, combined with only two houses implied elsewhere, doesn't directly determine Dev and Leo's house relationship from this claim alone.
Knowing Yara and Dev are in different houses doesn't by itself tell us about Yara and Leo's houses without knowing the total number of houses.
That Yara and Dev are in different houses doesn't establish how many houses the school has.
Sami's age relative to Dev has no bearing on Ivo's arrival time relative to Leo.
If Sami is younger than Dev, this is independent of Sami being older than Ivo, so neither confirms nor contradicts.
Sami being taller than Leo doesn't establish that Sami was easy to spot from a distance in general.
Sami's height relative to Leo is unrelated to Ivo's arrival time relative to Dev's bag-filling.
Sami being taller than Leo and shorter than Ivo are compatible height comparisons that don't contradict each other.
Sami being easy to spot has no connection to the difficulty of removing tangled fishing line.
Sami's visibility from a distance has no bearing on Dev and Leo's house assignments.
Sami being easy to spot doesn't relate to a height comparison between Sami and Ivo.
Sami's visibility is unrelated to the number of houses at the school.
Ivo taking photographs doesn't relate to the timing of Ivo's arrival relative to Leo.
If the tide pools held tangled fishing line, this supports the claim that the tangled fishing line took extra care to remove, since it establishes the fishing line's presence and entangled nature.
